hostTools.name: stripe
hostTools.reason: Run local Stripe webhook forwarding and payment test flows for landing-page subscriptions, bundles, and coupons
hostTools.notes: Use the Stripe CLI to forward /api/v1/webhooks/stripe and trigger test events during scenario validation

postgres.description: Primary relational data store for generated landing pages (content, variants, metrics, subscriptions)

service.description: Generated landing page scenario from template 'landing-page-business-suite'
service.name: landing-page-business-suite

logs.rationale: Scenario operational logs observed in the canonical logs directory.

budget.rationale: Regenerable storage is retained for 30 days and reclaimed by age; the window is the workload retention requirement.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

descriptors.label: Session signing secret
descriptors.description: Signs session cookies. Landing Page Business Suite mints this on first start and stores it in the credential authority; there is nothing for an operator to enter.

descriptors.label: Retired session signing secret
descriptors.description: Previous session signing secret retained for verification after rotation; LPBS writes it during rotation and there is nothing for an operator to enter.

descriptors.label: Service-to-service token
descriptors.description: Service-to-service token minted by Landing Page Business Suite and stored in the credential authority; there is nothing for an operator to enter.

descriptors.label: API key encryption key
descriptors.description: Versioned encryption ring minted by LPBS. Losing it makes sealed API-key rows unreadable; there is nothing for an operator to enter.

descriptors.label: Remote profile encryption key
descriptors.description: Independent versioned encryption ring minted by LPBS. Losing it makes sealed remote profiles unreadable; there is nothing for an operator to enter.

descriptors.label: Seeded admin password
descriptors.description: Password for the seeded admin account. Resolve it through the credential authority; it is never injected into the LPBS process environment.

descriptors.label: Consumer token signing key
descriptors.description: Private RSA key minted by Landing Page Business Suite and stored in the credential authority. Never distribute it to bundled scenarios.

descriptors.label: Stripe restricted secret key
descriptors.description: Authenticates server-side Stripe API requests. Obtain it from the Stripe dashboard.

descriptors.label: Stripe webhook signing secret
descriptors.description: Verifies inbound Stripe webhook signatures. Obtain it from the Stripe dashboard.

descriptors.label: Stripe publishable key
descriptors.description: Public client key used by the browser checkout flow.

descriptors.label: Download bucket access key ID
descriptors.description: Optional account identifier for signing desktop download URLs; leave unset when using an instance role.

descriptors.label: Download bucket secret access key
descriptors.description: Optional signing key for desktop download URLs; leave unset when using an instance role.

descriptors.label: Download bucket session token
descriptors.description: Optional session token for temporary download-bucket credentials.
